<infobox theme="Tactics">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Historical information</header>
        <data source="creator"><label>Creator(s)</label></data>
        <data source="date"><label>Date created</label></data>	
        <data source="first"><label>First employed</label></data>	
        <data source="last"><label>Last employed</label></data>			
        <data source="notable"><label>Notable employments</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Organizational information</header>
        <data source="purpose"><label>Purpose</label></data>
        <data source="requisites"><label>Requisites</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Other information</header>
        <data source="utilized"><label>Utilized by</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Tactics|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
